editorial.blurb: This unassuming West Ohio spot serves authentic, expertly executed tacos with flavors that'll have you coming back again and again.
editorial.insiderTip: Order the samosa taco—a reviewer's surprise favorite—and don't skip the fries, which are surprisingly well-seasoned with a slight kick.

topDishes.note: Incredibly flavorful with an amazing sauce
Always fresh, perfectly balanced, and a personal favorite
